steps.note: Open an existing event so its participant list can be tested.
Open the events list, the first subject under test.
Confirm the events list rendered normally before searching.
Enter the SQL-like string as literal search text in the events list.
Verify the events search reaches the normal empty-result state.
Confirm the events search produced no application error or server failure.
Open the published event's participant list.
Enter the same SQL-like string as literal search text in the participant list.
Verify the participant search reaches the normal empty-result state.
Confirm the participant search produced no application error or server failure.
